OUH Svendborg is a healthcare facility participating in the Danish national effort to standardize and improve the diagnostics of inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) via the DANIBD database. In the 2024 DANIBD report, the facility's diagnostic performance was evaluated against central quality indicators for IBD care. 

OUH Svendborg was identified as one of four departments—alongside [[hvidovre|Hvidovre]], [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]], and [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]]—that failed to fulfill the requirements for [[indikator-1a|Indikator 1a]] [^src1]. This specific indicator tracks whether newly diagnosed adult IBD patients are examined in accordance with clinical recommendations. At OUH Svendborg, less than 70% of newly diagnosed adults were examined according to these guidelines, marking the facility as an area with a potential diagnostic deficiency for adult IBD patients [^src1].
